initial_corpus: A fresh directory populated only with the two files in fuzz/online-reclamation-worker-seeds
limitations: This short coverage-guided run is not exhaustive.
The generated client operations are serial; independent tests exercise concurrent clients and shutdown behavior.
This run does not inject filesystem failures or simulate physical power loss or off-host restore.
exploratory_run: An earlier 3,710-input run used a pre-existing local corpus of 234 files in addition to the checked-in seeds; that complete initial corpus was not retained and its run is not reproducible from the seeds alone.
